remarks: Location! Location! Location! This unit is located right off Connecticut Ave., near shopping, public transportation, restaurants, SoNo Mall, beaches, parks, golf courses, and quick access to I-95, Metro North Train Station and so much more! Units are side by side with separate entrances. This unit features a large living room, generous kitchen with pantry, dinning area and half bath on main level. Second floor has 2 great size bedrooms with newer wall to wall carpet and a full bathroom. Lower level provides washer, dryer, and 2-car attached garage. Unit also comes with extra parking spaces, central AC, hardwood floors, freshly painted, equipped with security system wiring and additional storage in the basement and attic. Won't last!
